newsitem.title: UK: EMI down as report stokes music sales fears.
newsitem.headline: EMI down as report stokes music sales fears.

text.p: Shares in EMI Plc dropped on Wednesday after a report in the Financial Times added to concerns over a slowdown in music sales, traders said.

The stock was down 17p at 12.78 stg by 1238 GMT, near its lowest point since the spin-off of retail arm Thorn. The FT said industry figures showed fewer platinum, gold and silver awards for best-selling albums were given in the third quarter of this year than a year before, reflecting what it said was the subdued state of the UK music market.

Last week, EMI shares came under pressure after a report from the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry said worldwide sales were only marginally up in the first half of 1996 and in real terms actually fell.
No-one at EMI was immediately available for comment.
